_about: Conditions of the deliberation step (before the comparisons). The dev drawer chooses one per session; config.personal.deliberation.condition is the default. open: one instruction, nothing else. static: fixed questions, the next one shown after each recording and every intervalSeconds of silence. adaptive: after each recording a model writes the next question from what was said (prompts/deliberation-adaptive.md). Prompts ask about the process, never suggest content.

open.label: Open think-aloud
open.intro: Before anything is written, think the task through aloud. Say everything that comes to mind: what you want to achieve, who you are writing to, what you would say and how. There are no wrong answers.

static.label: Static metacognitive prompts
static.intro: Before anything is written, think the task through aloud. Questions will appear to help you; answer the ones that are useful.
prompts: What do you want to achieve with this text?
Who will read it, and what matters to them right now?
How would you usually approach a task like this?
Which points would you make, and which one matters most?
What could make the readers say no?
How should the text feel to the readers?
What have you not thought about yet?

adaptive.label: Adaptive prompts
adaptive.intro: Before anything is written, think the task through aloud. After each recording you get a question that builds on what you said.
adaptive.first: What do you want to achieve with this, and how would you go about it?
